mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.user_id AS userId, b.title, b.description, b.images, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.comments, b.publish_time AS publishTime, u.nick_name AS name, u.avatar AS icon FROM tb_blog b JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.publish_time DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

#{blogId}

SELECT b.id, b.user_id AS userId, b.title, b.description, b.images, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.content_object_key AS contentObjectKey, b.comments, b.status, b.publish_time AS publishTime, b.create_time AS createTime, b.update_time AS updateTime, u.nick_name AS name, u.avatar AS icon FROM tb_blog b JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.id = #{blogId} LIMIT 1
